violations.why: The higher-priority compute ISR can preempt RR ISR between its write and read-back, so the read can return 1 instead of 0.
The compute ISR can preempt between the two reads in the RR ISR, so they can return different values.
The compute ISR can overwrite the value between the RR write and its later read.
The compute ISR (higher priority) can preempt FL ISR between its two writes and read an intermediate value.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h between the RR ISR's write and its later use.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h between the RR ISR's write and its later use in the else branch.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 after the RR ISR writes it and before RR reads it.
The compute ISR can change RT4 between the two reads in the RR ISR, so the reads can disagree.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 after the FL ISR writes it and before FL reads it.
The compute ISR can change RT4 between the two reads in the FL ISR, so the reads can disagree.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT3 between the FL ISR's write and its later read.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT3 between the FL ISR's write and its later read in the else branch.
